banner.const: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

historical_mentions.description: Case IDs of other figures with records (or planned records) whom this record names on purpose in its documented history, for example a correspondent or rival. The cross-case name check skips their names; their MRNs are still never allowed. The modern episode never attributes statements, decisions or health facts to them.

name_parts.description: Given and family names for C-CDA and FHIR when splitting display_name at the last space would be wrong, for example family-name-first names (Sun Yat-sen) or titles (Diana, Princess of Wales). A person known by a single name with no given/family division (Sitting Bull) has an empty given array and the name as family. Omit for ordinary names.

family_first.description: True when the family name is written first (Sun Yat-sen). The C-CDA name lists <family> before <given>.

era.description: Roster era, used for dataset balance reporting.

nationality.description: Roster nationality, as recorded in the master roster.

ssn.description: Made-up Social Security number. The 000 area number is never issued, so it cannot belong to a real person.

calendar_frame.description: Canonical cases are modern_shifted. true_date appears only in cases derived by scripts/derive_true_date_case.mjs.

safety_assessment.description: Structured present-day suicide and self-harm risk assessment. Validation requires it when the episode has a behavioral-health problem or a positive depression screen.

oxygen_context.description: How the oxygen saturation was measured, for example "on the ventilator via tracheostomy" or "on 2 L/min oxygen by nasal cannula". The notes print "on room air" when omitted.

recorded_date.description: Visit date at which the diagnosis was made. Earlier visits' documents do not list the problem. Omit for problems known at the index visit.

abatement_date.description: Visit date at which the problem resolved or was superseded, for example a presenting breast mass once the biopsy gives the diagnosis. Documents dated earlier show it as active; documents on or after this date show it as resolved. Requires clinical_status resolved.

coding.description: RxNorm clinical drug; era remedies map to a modern equivalent.

historical_remedy.description: Era remedy this entry maps from, for example laudanum.

as_needed.description: Taken as needed (PRN). The period is then the shortest allowed interval between doses.

familyHistory.description: Real relatives of real people: only documented or retrospective content, never synthetic.

pastMedicalHistory.description: True biography. Dates are historical and never enter the synthetic timeline.

observation.description: A scored instrument (survey, the default), a laboratory result, or an imaging measurement. Laboratory and imaging results need a reference range and an interpretation flag; results drawn together share a panel.

label.description: Short clinical name used in note prose, such as ALT or HbA1c.

encounterDocumentation.description: Full encounter documentation for a visit written as a complete note: chief complaint, history of present illness, review of systems, examination, and assessment and plan. Wellness visits add a health risk assessment, a personalized prevention plan, and advance care planning. A focused chronic-care visit adds a protocol monitoring table: every item the condition's monitoring protocol (CMID or the specialty guideline) calls for at this point, with its interval and status.

billing_note.description: Service codes as plain text, such as HCPCS G0439 with CPT 99497.

problem_id.description: Problem list entry this item addresses, if any.

guideline_ids.description: Guidelines this visit follows. Guidelines cited only by visits are left out of the intake H&P and consultation guideline lists.

health_risk_assessment_method.description: How the health risk assessment was completed. Defaults to self-completion before the visit.

observation_ids.description: Results recorded for this item at this visit.

encounter.description: A synthetic visit. visit_type defaults to chronic_care; sick visits are unscheduled. Visits with documentation are written as full encounter notes.

consultation.description: The referral and the specialist's consultation, written for this case. Without it the referral and consultation documents fall back to generic text.

recorded_date.description: Visit date at which this step was decided (for example chemotherapy chosen after surgery). Documents dated earlier do not list it. Omit for steps planned at the index visit.
